description: ☰ → Mesh, in Baude and Record, and ⋮ → Mesh in the Android app: each machine in the mesh, and each host the app knows (greyed while it isn't reached), with the code its daemon and the apps on it (Baude, Record, Emission; a phone's, the Android app) run against the newest in the mesh; and each one's ⋮, to rename it or remove it on this device.

messages.title: Mesh
messages.none: Not connected to a host process
messages.rename_body: The name it has on this device only. Left empty, it has its own: {$name}.
messages.remove_body: It isn't listed on this device any more, nor are its chats, and this device's link to it is let go of, till it's added again. Nothing on the host changes.
